notes.title: Releasing What's Left of the Game
notes.content: [p]Hello! Yeah, I finally got around to getting what's left of the game released and archived.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5Qu-XMmn5MA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]For those not in the know, this game is ""cancelled"", or rather, "Indefinitley Postponed". So yeah basically cancelled. For more details surrounding all of it, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3109230/view/508455949840681450"]read the previous announcement[/url]. This steam page won't be up for much longer, but hey, there's a chance I could suddenly want to finish the game. I uh. I don't think that's happening but you never know I suppose.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, onto the details. Yes! You can play the game right now, 2 versions of it as a matter of fact. See, during this game's development I actually restarted development about halfway through, since I felt the old version wasn't good enough at all. Both the old (2024) and new (2025) versions are now available for you to play![/p][p][/p][p]I don't know why you would like... want to, but you can.[/p][p][/p][h1]"WHERE CAN I PLAY THEM JUST GET TO IT ALREADY OH MY GOD??"[/h1][p][url="https://bigctheman345.itch.io/call-of-the-deep"]You can play them both for free here, on itch.io[/url]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/933d5e2d7c591e66e6d091bba2eb368c4a49a6d7.png"][/img][/p][p]I would reccomend playing the build labelled "New 2025 Version". It's the game shown on steam, and the old one is nearly a completley different game. I only uploaded it for curious people and for archival purposes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/fcc36310917fef42935975a8122eaa2e3bac1d49.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Also...[/h1][p]I have finished the Artstation page for the game! I use artstation both as a portfolio and as a way for anyone interested to see behind the scenes content of the game. If you're interested in seeing development footage, concept art, model workflows, cut and unfinished content and more, you can check out the [url="https://www.artstation.com/artwork/nJeqX9"]Call of the Deep project document on Artstation[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/7fb5946bbe585ca555a7f9620b8672de4bec88f7.png"][/img][/p][h1]Also Also...[/h1][p]The soundtrack for the new version has been released and is rolling out on most popular music streaming services. It should be up within this week. The only exceptions are Soundcloud, Apple music and Itunes. I talk about why in the youtube video at the top.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/3728105178828c2e833347a7e108b8255b135fb7.png"][/img][/p][h1]Lastly...[/h1][p][/p][p]I just wanna say thank you if you're reading this! This project has taught me a lot and it's the longest time I've ever spent working on something. Even though it is sad to see it go, I think it's for the best. There were just too many issues with the game for me to continue making it. I promise I will go into A LOT more detail once my developer commentary YouTube video is done. For now, if you were waiting for the game, this is all that was finished, ever. So hopefully you'll get something out of this. I personally am I happy I never have to touch this godforsaken thing ever again ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p]See ya,[/p][p]-bigctheman345[/p]

notes.title: Call of the Deep Is Suspended Indefinitely
notes.content:
Yeah

Ok but for real, if you haven't been keeping up with my socials or if you're just stumbling upon this game for the first time, let me make it very clear:

[h1]The chances of this game ever releasing are very slim[/h1]

[h2]"Awesome, but why?"[/h2]

Mostly comes down to personal issues with the project that I won't post here, but don't worry, you'll get to hear me whine about it some day. I will be explaining all of this in a video or two uploaded to my youtube which I will hopefully post in the announcements here, so if you don't see it, I haven't done it yet.

[h2]"Are you ever gonna finish the game?"[/h2]

This one really depends, since I'm an individual person on my own working on a game, how I'm feeling at the time will dictate if said work will be even be done. If I had to give you a solid answer though, probably not, sorry.

[h2]"Will anything of the game ever be released?"[/h2]

Yes! Everything I have done will be released to the public in some way. I plan to release the demo and beta builds to the public sometime over the coming months alongside that postmortem video I was talking about. I can also share some photos in the meantime:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/66cca38d5f44dc8791ca1ee30c7731ecc3421e11.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/7ef6b8a5d583fb774a59af15130934278e1a0396.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127220/0aa985e78faf0504f0d54defa6d06780974d2d31.png[/img]

All will be revealed soon, and maybe when you play it, you'll realise why I called it quits here.

[h2]"If the game is cancelled, then why is the game page up?"[/h2]

Well, because there is the slim chance I will pick this back up, I have decided for a small time (maybe about a year or so) to leave the store page up. After that, if I still have no intentions of picking Call of the Deep back up then the steam page is gonna go.

[h1]Thank you to anyone who wishlisted my game, it means a lot to me, really. [/h1] 
(and hopefully you weren't too eager to play this one lol.)

The project has been a huge learning experience and I'm glad so many people showed interest, so truly, [b]thank you[/b] for reading. If you have questions, send me a message on, like, anything, you can find whatever way you want to contact me on my [url=https://linktr.ee/bigctheman345]linktree[/url].

- Adam (bigctheman345)
